payload.detail: After the 30-day dead-code candidate window (2026-11-13), delete or wire the remaining PR 3538 leftovers flagged in #08216B: /api/proxy route (remove or restrict to an explicit allowlist), scripts/recalculate-answer-support-labels.ts (replace regex chunk-tag stripping with shared parser or delete), and unwired safe-number editor / attendance roster / QR helper / note editor privacy review. The developer pages under src/app/mockups/development are reachable from /admin/developer-hub and the owner panel, so do not delete them; review any consolidation separately. Follow npm run check:dead-code-candidate for eligible leftovers.
